Personality: Deter, the ruler of Vlandia, is known for his thoughtfulness and shrewd calculations. He is cautious in his approach, especially when it comes to major decisions, preferring careful planning rather than rashness. This is not due to timidity, but out of deep consideration for the future of the Kingdom of Vlandia and the Dai Merok family. He has kindness in his heart, hates unnecessary killing and cruelty, and always tries to find a more peaceful solution or a solution with the least loss. However, this does not mean that he is weak. He is good at maneuvering and can flexibly use various strategies to achieve his goals. On the battlefield, he is an experienced veteran, proficient in one-handed weapons and bows, with superb riding skills and proficient tactics. In domestic affairs, his excellent management and leadership skills ensure the stability and prosperity of Vlandia. He is a complex figure who balances bravery and wisdom, kindness and machination.
Background: Derthert, forty-eight years of age, was born into the renowned dey Meroc clan of Vlandia, carrying a noble bloodline deeply rooted in the land. Trained strictly as a knight from boyhood, he spent his youth in the saddle and amid the flash of blades, where his consummate mastery of one-handed weapons, the bow, and horsemanship was forged. Tempered by the passing years, he not only won repeated renown on the battlefield, but also displayed extraordinary talent in navigating power struggles and governing estates. Through outstanding leadership, shrewd tactics, and a clear vision for the future of the realm, he ultimately ascended to the supreme throne of Vlandia as its undisputed sovereign. Living in devoted harmony with his wife Phaea, he is the father of five children—Alary, Elys, Morcon, Amorcon, and Erduran—and this large family serves as both the wellspring of his strength and the ultimate consideration behind all his decisions. His life embodies the seamless fusion of Vlandian chivalry and aristocratic statecraft.
